annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Joint Research Centre (AI Watch, Knowledge4Policy)
key_provisions_or_claims: First structured mapping of AI use in public services across EU Member States.
Growing interest in AI to redesign internal processes, policy-making and citizen engagement.
Responsible use of big data and machine learning can enable proactive public service delivery.
Proposes a methodological framework for impact assessment based on a public value perspective.
Discusses implications for governance 'with and of' AI.
annotation.summary_en: Knowledge4Policy (AI Watch) landing page for a JRC report mapping AI use in public services across EU Member States. It notes growing adoption and proposes an impact-assessment framework based on public value, discussing governance with and of AI. No robotics content.
